introduction.situation: Mathematics spans a very large body of specialised areas that were published under several different schemes.
introduction.complication: The areas mix pure structures, computing methods, uses in other sciences and the history and teaching of the discipline, and some appear twice under different names.
introduction.question: How is everything in mathematics divided?
introduction.answer: Mathematics is divided by the role its knowledge plays into the structures it studies, the computation and inference it performs, the modelling of other fields' claims, and the discipline as a human activity.

governing_thought: Mathematics is divided by the role its knowledge plays into the structures it studies, the computation and inference it performs, the modelling of other fields' claims, and the discipline as a human activity.

key_line.rank_note: The roles run from pure structure, through computation and inference, to modelling of outside claims, and finally to the discipline as a human activity.

points.title: Structures
points.statement: Structures are the role in which mathematics studies abstract objects such as algebraic systems, spaces, functions and the foundations of proof for their own sake.
points.name: Structures are the role in which mathematics studies abstract objects such as algebraic systems, spaces, functions and the foundations of proof for their own sake.

support.rank_note: Kinds run from algebra to geometry and topology, then analysis, then foundations.

points.statement: Algebraic structures are systems defined by operations and their neighbouring arithmetic and combinatorial areas, which study the same operational objects.
points.name: Algebraic structures are systems defined by operations and their neighbouring arithmetic and combinatorial areas, which study the same operational objects.

support.rank_note: From general algebraic systems to neighbouring areas to groups.

points.statement: Algebraic structure areas study systems defined by operations such as rings, fields and algebras.
points.name: Algebraic structure areas study systems defined by operations such as rings, fields and algebras.

points.statement: Neighbouring areas are fields that border algebra through combinatorial, order, arithmetic, matrix or K-theoretic methods.
points.name: Neighbouring areas are fields that border algebra through combinatorial, order, arithmetic, matrix or K-theoretic methods.

points.statement: Linear and multilinear algebra; matrix theory
points.name: Linear and multilinear algebra; matrix theory

points.statement: Group-based areas study groups and their generalizations, including topological and Lie groups.
points.name: Group-based areas study groups and their generalizations, including topological and Lie groups.

points.statement: Geometric and topological structures are spaces studied through figures, equations, smooth structure and global shape.
points.name: Geometric and topological structures are spaces studied through figures, equations, smooth structure and global shape.

support.rank_note: From elementary geometry to algebraic and differential geometry to topology.

points.statement: Geometry and convex and discrete geometry are kinds of classical and elementary geometric study of figures, convex sets and discrete configurations.
points.name: Geometry and convex and discrete geometry are kinds of classical and elementary geometric study of figures, convex sets and discrete configurations.

support.rank_note: Ranked from the most elementary field to the more specialized one.

points.statement: Algebraic geometry and differential geometry are kinds of geometry that study spaces through algebraic equations or through calculus and smooth structure.
points.name: Algebraic geometry and differential geometry are kinds of geometry that study spaces through algebraic equations or through calculus and smooth structure.

support.rank_note: Ranked from the more concrete smooth setting to the more abstract algebraic setting.

points.statement: General topology, algebraic topology, manifolds and global analysis are kinds of topological and analytic study of the shape and global structure of spaces.
points.name: General topology, algebraic topology, manifolds and global analysis are kinds of topological and analytic study of the shape and global structure of spaces.

support.rank_note: Ranked from foundational point-set topology to the more structured and analytic fields.

points.statement: Analytic structures are functions, equations, transforms, function spaces and operators studied through limits and continuity.
points.name: Analytic structures are functions, equations, transforms, function spaces and operators studied through limits and continuity.

support.rank_note: From core classical analysis to the abstract frameworks that generalise it.

points.statement: Core analysis areas are the classical subfields that study functions, equations, and transforms directly in real, complex, differential, and harmonic settings.
points.name: Core analysis areas are the classical subfields that study functions, equations, and transforms directly in real, complex, differential, and harmonic settings.

points.statement: Real-variable foundations study real functions, measure, integration, and the convergence and approximation of sequences and series.
points.name: Real-variable foundations study real functions, measure, integration, and the convergence and approximation of sequences and series.

support.rank_note: Ordered from basic functions to measure to series and approximation.

points.statement: Complex and potential-theoretic analysis studies holomorphic functions in one or several variables, together with harmonic potentials and special functions.
points.name: Complex and potential-theoretic analysis studies holomorphic functions in one or several variables, together with harmonic potentials and special functions.

points.statement: Several complex variables and analytic spaces
points.name: Several complex variables and analytic spaces

support.rank_note: Ordered from one complex variable to potential theory to several variables and special functions.

points.statement: Equation-based analysis studies differential, difference, functional, and integral equations and the dynamics of their solutions.
points.name: Equation-based analysis studies differential, difference, functional, and integral equations and the dynamics of their solutions.

support.rank_note: Ordered from ordinary and partial differential equations to dynamics, difference equations, and integral equations.

points.statement: Harmonic analysis and transform methods decompose functions into frequency components on Euclidean spaces and on abstract groups, and apply integral transforms.
points.name: Harmonic analysis and transform methods decompose functions into frequency components on Euclidean spaces and on abstract groups, and apply integral transforms.

support.rank_note: Ordered from Euclidean to abstract settings to integral transforms.
Ordered structurally from real foundations to complex, equation-based, and harmonic analysis.

points.statement: Function spaces and operators generalise analysis, and their methods are applied to optimization and variational problems.
points.name: Function spaces and operators generalise analysis, and their methods are applied to optimization and variational problems.

points.statement: Calculus of variations and optimal control; optimization
points.name: Calculus of variations and optimal control; optimization

support.rank_note: Ordered from abstract spaces to operators to applied optimization.

points.statement: Foundational structures are the logical and categorical frameworks in which mathematical objects and proofs are expressed.
points.name: Foundational structures are the logical and categorical frameworks in which mathematical objects and proofs are expressed.

support.rank_note: From logic to category theory.

points.title: Computation and inference
points.statement: Computation and inference is the role in which mathematics computes results by algorithms and infers conclusions from chance and data.
points.name: Computation and inference is the role in which mathematics computes results by algorithms and infers conclusions from chance and data.

support.rank_note: From chance and data to the algorithms that compute with them.

points.statement: Numerical analysis and computer science are computation-centered fields of mathematics that study algorithms and their behavior.
points.name: Numerical analysis and computer science are computation-centered fields of mathematics that study algorithms and their behavior.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure: numerical analysis first as the narrower field, then computer science as the broader field.

points.title: Modelling
points.statement: Modelling is the role in which mathematics expresses another field's claims about physical, living, social and decision systems in mathematical language.
points.name: Modelling is the role in which mathematics expresses another field's claims about physical, living, social and decision systems in mathematical language.

support.rank_note: From macroscopic physics to fundamental physics to mathematical physics to systems and decision sciences.

points.statement: Classical mechanics and continuum field theories model macroscopic physical bodies, media, and fields.
points.name: Classical mechanics and continuum field theories model macroscopic physical bodies, media, and fields.

support.rank_note: Ordered from discrete particles to deformable solids, fluids, electromagnetic fields, and heat.

points.statement: Fundamental and cosmic physics theories model matter, spacetime, and the universe at the smallest and largest scales.
points.name: Fundamental and cosmic physics theories model matter, spacetime, and the universe at the smallest and largest scales.

support.rank_note: Ordered from quantum and statistical foundations to gravity, astronomy, and the Earth.

points.statement: Mathematical physics applies mathematical methods to model physical phenomena and their governing equations.
points.name: Mathematical physics applies mathematical methods to model physical phenomena and their governing equations.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure: the theory-oriented field of mathematical physics comes first, then the computation-oriented field.

points.statement: Systems and decision sciences apply mathematics to optimization, social and living systems, control, and information.
points.name: Systems and decision sciences apply mathematics to optimization, social and living systems, control, and information.

points.statement: Game theory, economics, finance, and other social and behavioral sciences
points.name: Game theory, economics, finance, and other social and behavioral sciences

support.rank_note: Ordered from optimization and social decisions to biology, control, and information.

points.title: Discipline
points.statement: The discipline is the role in which mathematics is a human activity with a history, a teaching practice and a general literature.
points.name: The discipline is the role in which mathematics is a human activity with a history, a teaching practice and a general literature.

support.rank_note: From general overview to history to teaching.
